title: OpenAI and Dell Technologies partner to bring Codex to hybrid and on-premises enterprise environments
content: OpenAI and Dell partner to bring Codex to hybrid and on-premise environments, helping enterprises deploy AI coding agents securely across data and workflows.

title: A new personal finance experience in ChatGPT
content: Preview a new personal finance experience in ChatGPT for Pro users in the U.S. Securely connect your financial accounts and get AI-powered insights and guidance grounded in your financial context, goals, and priorities.

title: Work with Codex from anywhere
content: Use Codex anywhere with the ChatGPT mobile app. Monitor, steer, and approve coding tasks in real time across devices and remote environments.

title: Helping ChatGPT better recognize context in sensitive conversations
content: Learn how new ChatGPT safety updates improve context awareness in sensitive conversations, helping detect risk over time and respond more safely.

title: Introducing GPT-5.5

title: Introducing GPT-5.3-Codex

title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.7
content: Our latest model, Claude Opus 4.7, is now generally available. Opus 4.7 is a notable improvement on Opus 4.6 in advanced software engineering, with particular gains on the most difficult tasks.

title: Introducing Claude Design by Anthropic Labs
content: Today, we’re launching Claude Design, a new Anthropic Labs product that lets you collaborate with Claude to create polished visual work like designs, prototypes, slides, one-pagers, and more.

title: Claude is a space to think
content: We’ve made a choice: Claude will remain ad-free. We explain why advertising incentives are incompatible with a genuinely helpful AI assistant, and how we plan to expand access without compromising user trust.

title: Higher usage limits for Claude and a compute deal with SpaceX
